variants.title: ESR hyperfine sextet of Mn2+ in MgO
variants.sample: MgO crystal doped with Mn2+ (S = 5/2, I = 5/2) (SIMULATED)
variants.note: Six hyperfine lines; second-order terms make the spacing uneven, but the outermost pair is exactly 5A apart. g = 2.0014 and |A| = 8.67 mT quoted from memory - verify; the fine-structure lines of the cubic site are not modelled.

source.title: Abragam and Bleaney, Electron Paramagnetic Resonance of Transition Ions (1970)

variants.title: ESR of an irradiated organic radical: proton doublet
variants.sample: X-irradiated malonic acid, the CH(COOH)2 radical (SIMULATED)
variants.note: One alpha proton (I = 1/2) splits the line into a doublet; its spacing is the isotropic part of the proton coupling (about 2.1 mT in powder - verify). g and A quoted from memory - verify.

source.title: H. M. McConnell, C. Heller, T. Cole and R. W. Fessenden, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 82, 766 (1960)
